chatglm.cn.note: Access token in cookie chatglm_token (SameSite=None, Secure, Expires=30d); refresh token in chatglm_refresh_token (180d); user id in chatglm_user_id. Refresh via POST /chatglm/user-api/user/refresh (Bearer refresh_token) → rewrites cookies. Cookie domain: .chatglm.cn. Also /chatglm/backend-api/v2/user/login?satoken={satoken} for SSO login.

chat.z.ai.note: JWT stored in localStorage key 'token' (set on session load: localStorage.token = T.token where T = GET /api/v1/auths/ response {id,email,name,role,token}). No explicit refresh mechanism found — JWT may be long-lived. OAuth route: /auth?action=signup. Bootstrap: window.GLOBAL_FETCHES.session = fetch('/api/v1/auths/').
